description: This file defines classes for a WebBridge SDK implementing JSON-RPC communication over WebSockets. It includes classes for managing JSON-RPC clients, services, and a service manager to coordinate communication and method dispatching.

classes.name: JsonRpcClient
classes.description: Manages a JSON-RPC client over WebSocket, handling request sending, responses, and incoming messages.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service with methods that can be registered and invoked via JSON-RPC.

classes.name: ServiceManager
classes.description: Coordinates multiple services, manages WebSocket connections, and forwarding of JSON-RPC messages.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and opens the WebSocket connection for the JSON-RPC client.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request with specified method and parameters, returning a promise that resolves with the response.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a notification message via WebSocket (implementation is minimal).

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a JSON message over WebSocket.

methods.name: _onIncomingMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages, resolving corresponding promises for requests.

methods.name: registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a method with the service instance.

methods.name: _callMethodByName
methods.description: Invokes a registered method by name with given parameters.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens WebSocket connection for the ServiceManager, initializing the JSON-RPC client.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a new service with the ServiceManager and initiates cloning and activation.

methods.name: _connectService
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for a specific service and sets up message handlers.

methods.name: _controllerActivateService
methods.description: Requests activation of a service via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: _sendResponse
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC response over a WebSocket.

methods.name: _controllerCloneService
methods.description: Requests cloning of a service via JSON-RPC.
